```yaml
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up stable rust
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
    - run: cargo build --verbose
    - run: cargo test --verbose


name: Format

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up stable rust
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
    - run: cargo fmt --all --check
```
